avoid.flag: Shows up as a smart lock, has no app, Bluetooth, or Wi-Fi
avoid.verdict: It's a decent keypad deadbolt, but it isn't a smart lock. It appears in smart lock search results with no connectivity at all.
reasons: The listing says "No app. No phone setup. No Wi-Fi."
With no wireless radio, it can't join any smart home system or send alerts.
Codes can only be managed at the lock, up to 20 of them.
If you want a connected lock for a similar price, the Veise VE017 and DESLOC B200 above cost less.
